Delete the comments as you fill this in. Keep it short and concrete: a newcomer should be able to

New issues here are drafted and approved by their author before they are created (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
-->

## Why

<!-- One or two sentences: what is wrong or missing, and who it helps. -->

## Scope

<!-- What to change, as a short list. Name the files or folders. -->

- <file or folder to change>

## Out of scope

<!-- What this issue must not touch, so the PR stays small. -->

- <what not to touch>

## Done when

<!-- Checks the author or reviewer can tick. -->

- [ ] <check>

## Read first

<!-- The few docs or files needed to do this, as links. Nothing more. -->

- <link to a doc or file>

## Mentor

<!-- Who to ask when stuck (GitHub handle). They answer in this issue. -->

@<github-handle>

Branch from `dev` and open the PR against `dev`. Title it `Issue-<n>: <title>` and put `Closes #<n>` in the body. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/0ffrian/SphereX/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-pr).
